def transform(A, B):
    if len(A) != len(B) or any(char not in B for char in A):
        return -1
    
    # Calculate the cost to move each character in A to the front of A
    cost = [0] * len(A)
    for i in range(len(A)):
        j = B.find(A[i])
        cost[i] = j - i if j >= i else len(A) + j - i
    
    # The minimum number of steps is the sum of all individual costs
    return sum(cost)
